title: Collection
description: A versioned set of entries of one type, the unit of sync with the future API.

version.description: Bumped by hand whenever the content changes.

Article.description:
A rules summary (combat turn, cover, wound states, ...): a short line for hints and an optional
longer card for the reference. Core rules text lives in the locale files under
`article.<id>.{name,summary,details}`; the keys are fixed by that convention, see
[`validate_articles`].

details_key.description: Full description in own words; `None` when the summary says it all.

summary_key.description: One phrase: what it is, shown in hints.

Source.description: Where a value comes from in the rulebook.

page.description: Printed page number (PDF page minus one).
